Maya Patel: Heads-up: hiring freeze for non-customer-facing ICs is lifted effective today. We're still prioritizing infra, security, and customer success roles. Owen Reed will transition from Staff SWE (runtime) to Manager, Runtime Platform on 2025-05-12 to backfill a leadership gap.

Owen Reed: Appreciate the trust. I'll shadow the current manager for two weeks and publish a short transition doc.

Leah Kim: Recruiting note: please file reqs for any prioritized hires in Lever and tag people-ops. We'll fast-track infra/security roles. For transfers like Owen's, follow the internal-transfer loop (1 manager + 1 peer).

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel updated the hiring policy doc and posted "Hiring freeze lifted: infra & CS prioritized"  see People Ops docs.

Priya Natarajan: For planning: team leads, update your hiring priority spreadsheet by EOD Friday so we can allocate headcount.

Ivy Chen: Quick Q: will this affect contractor conversions? We have two infra contractors up for conversion this quarter.

Maya Patel: Good Q. Contractor conversions for infra/security go ahead; others pending headcount approvals. Leah, please coordinate with finance on budget for those conversions.

Leah Kim: On it. I'll DM finance and update the reqs. If anyone needs exceptions, escalate to people-ops with justification.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. We
expect clearer runway now for critical hires. Ping me with questions or bring to the sync on Thurs.
